description: Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (VRPTW)

detailed_description.overview: A fleet of vehicles starts from a depot and serves all customers. Each customer has a demand, a service time and a time window. Each vehicle has a capacity limit. Minimize the total travel distance.

constraints.name: capacity_constraint
constraints.description: The total demand on each route must not exceed the vehicle capacity.
constraints.calculation: Sum the demands of all customers on a route.

constraints.name: time_window_constraint
constraints.description: Each customer must be served within its time window.
constraints.calculation: Arrival time must lie within [earliest, latest].

constraints.name: fleet_size_constraint
constraints.description: The number of vehicles used must not exceed the available fleet.

constraints.name: visit_constraint
constraints.description: Every customer must be visited exactly once.
constraints.calculation: Check that every customer appears exactly once across all routes.

objectives.name: minimize_total_distance
objectives.description: Minimize the total travel distance of all vehicles.
objectives.calculation: Sum the distance of every route.

route.description: A flat route list. 0 is the depot and consecutive 0s split routes.

parameters.coordinates: list of [x, y] coordinates for the depot and customers
parameters.demands: demand of each node (0 for the depot)
parameters.time_windows: time window [earliest, latest] of each node
